On the question before the files: when a room is open to anyone (join_policy: "open", personal: false) yet sets count_hidden: true, look should still give the conversation text (since anyone can join to read it anyway), but it should omit or anonymize the author IDs (for instance writing 1. said "first" or a room-local pseudonymous speaker number speaker #1 said "first" instead of 1. "did:key:..." said "first") or else refuse look altogether when count_hidden is true. Why: Door hides talk (said and speakers) whenever count_hidden is true because the number of speakers bounds the number of members (speakers <= members); if look prints every message's author did:key to an unjoined reader, anyone can count the distinct did:keys in look (defeating count_hidden for speakers and said) and learn who is inside from outside the room without ever crossing the threshold via Room::join.
src/doors.rs
use crate::commons::{
    verify_commons_log, verify_registration, CommonsLog,
    CommonsRecord,
};
use crate::did::DidKey;
use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::head::WorldHead;
use crate::record::Record;
use crate::room::RoomLog;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

pub const QUIET_FROM: u64 = 10;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum By {
    Members,
    Said,
    Speakers,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DoorLaw {
    pub join_policy: String,
    pub membership: String,
    pub moderation: String,
    pub mode: String,
    pub personal: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub welcome: Option<String>,
    pub count_hidden: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DoorCount {
    pub members: u64,
    pub at_record: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DoorTalk {
    pub said: u64,
    pub speakers: u64,
    pub at_record: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Door {
    pub room_id: DidKey,
    pub topic: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub own_topic: Option<String>,
    pub template_hash: String,
    pub registration_seq: u64,
    pub registration_hash: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub law: Option<DoorLaw>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub count: Option<DoorCount>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub talk: Option<DoorTalk>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DoorList {
    pub commons_id: DidKey,
    pub drawn_from: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub log_head: Option<String>,
    pub doors: Vec<Door>,
}

fn is_quiet_door(door: &Door) -> bool {
    match (&door.count, &door.talk) {
        (Some(c), Some(t)) => c.members >= QUIET_FROM && t.said == 0,
        _ => false,
    }
}

pub fn quiet(list: &DoorList) -> Vec<&Door> {
    list.doors.iter().filter(|d| is_quiet_door(d)).collect()
}

pub fn draw(log: &CommonsLog, rooms: &[RoomLog]) -> Result<DoorList> {
    verify_commons_log(log)?;

    let drawn_from = log.records.len() as u64;
    let log_head = match log.records.last() {
        Some(rec) => Some(rec.hash()?),
        None => None,
    };

    let mut reg_by_room: HashMap<DidKey, &crate::commons::RoomRegistered> = HashMap::new();
    for rec in &log.records {
        if let CommonsRecord::RoomRegistered(r) = rec {
            reg_by_room.insert(r.room_id.clone(), r);
        }
    }

    let mut rooms_by_id: HashMap<DidKey, &RoomLog> = HashMap::new();
    for room_log in rooms {
        let Some(&reg) = reg_by_room.get(&room_log.world_id) else {
            return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                "room {} is not registered in this Commons",
                room_log.world_id.as_str()
            )));
        };
        if rooms_by_id.insert(room_log.world_id.clone(), room_log).is_some() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                "duplicate room log for {}",
                room_log.world_id.as_str()
            )));
        }
        verify_registration(reg, room_log)?;
    }

    let mut doors = Vec::new();
    for rec in &log.records {
        if let CommonsRecord::RoomRegistered(r) = rec {
            let registration_hash = rec.hash()?;
            let (own_topic, law, count, talk) = if let Some(&room_log) = rooms_by_id.get(&r.room_id) {
                let mut present: HashSet<DidKey> = HashSet::new();
                for (idx, room_rec) in room_log.records.iter().enumerate() {
                    match room_rec {
                        Record::RoomCreated(rc) => {
                            present.insert(rc.creator_id.clone());
                        }
                        Record::Join(j) => {
                            present.insert(j.subject_id.clone());
                        }
                        Record::Leave(l) => {
                            if !present.remove(&l.subject_id) {
                                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                                    "room {} record {}: leave by non-member {}",
                                    room_log.world_id.as_str(),
                                    idx,
                                    l.subject_id.as_str()
                                )));
                            }
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                }

                let t = &room_log.template;
                let door_law = DoorLaw {
                    join_policy: t.join_policy.clone(),
                    membership: t.membership.clone(),
                    moderation: t.moderation.clone(),
                    mode: t.mode.clone(),
                    personal: t.personal,
                    welcome: t.welcome.clone(),
                    count_hidden: t.count_hidden,
                };
                let (door_count, door_talk) = if t.count_hidden {
                    (None, None)
                } else {
                    let at_record = room_log.records.len() as u64;
                    let visible = room_log.visible_log();
                    let mut said: u64 = 0;
                    let mut authors: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
                    for entry in &visible {
                        if entry["type"].as_str() == Some("message")
                            && entry["redacted"].as_bool() == Some(false)
                        {
                            said += 1;
                            if let Some(a) = entry["author"].as_str() {
                                authors.insert(a.to_string());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    (
                        Some(DoorCount {
                            members: present.len() as u64,
                            at_record,
                        }),
                        Some(DoorTalk {
                            said,
                            speakers: authors.len() as u64,
                            at_record,
                        }),
                    )
                };
                (Some(t.topic.clone()), Some(door_law), door_count, door_talk)
            } else {
                (None, None, None, None)
            };

            doors.push(Door {
                room_id: r.room_id.clone(),
                topic: r.topic.clone(),
                own_topic,
                template_hash: r.template_hash.clone(),
                registration_seq: r.seq,
                registration_hash,
                law,
                count,
                talk,
            });
        }
    }

    Ok(DoorList {
        commons_id: log.commons_id.clone(),
        drawn_from,
        log_head,
        doors,
    })
}

pub fn check(list: &DoorList, log: &CommonsLog, rooms: &[RoomLog]) -> Result<()> {
    let expected = draw(log, rooms)?;
    if list.commons_id != expected.commons_id {
        return Err(Error::Verification("door list: commons_id mismatch".into()));
    }
    if list.drawn_from != expected.drawn_from {
        return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
            "door list: drawn_from {} != expected {}",
            list.drawn_from, expected.drawn_from
        )));
    }
    if list.log_head != expected.log_head {
        return Err(Error::Verification("door list: log_head mismatch".into()));
    }
    if list.doors.len() != expected.doors.len() {
        return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
            "door list: door count {} != expected {}",
            list.doors.len(),
            expected.doors.len()
        )));
    }
    for (i, (got, exp)) in list.doors.iter().zip(expected.doors.iter()).enumerate() {
        if got != exp {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "door list: door at index {i} differs"
            )));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn verify_heads_against_rooms(rooms: &[RoomLog], heads: &[WorldHead]) -> Result<()> {
    for head in heads {
        let room_log = rooms
            .iter()
            .find(|r| r.world_id == head.world)
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                Error::Policy(format!(
                    "head names room {} whose log was not given",
                    head.world.as_str()
                ))
            })?;
        room_log.verify_head(head)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn draw_at(
    log: &CommonsLog,
    rooms: &[RoomLog],
    heads: &[WorldHead],
) -> Result<DoorList> {
    verify_heads_against_rooms(rooms, heads)?;
    draw(log, rooms)
}

pub fn check_at(
    list: &DoorList,
    log: &CommonsLog,
    rooms: &[RoomLog],
    heads: &[WorldHead],
) -> Result<()> {
    verify_heads_against_rooms(rooms, heads)?;
    check(list, log, rooms)
}

pub fn ranked_by(list: &DoorList, by: By) -> Vec<&Door> {
    let mut with_num: Vec<(usize, &Door, u64)> = Vec::new();
    let mut without_num: Vec<&Door> = Vec::new();

    for (idx, door) in list.doors.iter().enumerate() {
        let val = match by {
            By::Members => door.count.as_ref().map(|c| c.members),
            By::Said => door.talk.as_ref().map(|t| t.said),
            By::Speakers => door.talk.as_ref().map(|t| t.speakers),
        };
        match val {
            Some(v) => with_num.push((idx, door, v)),
            None => without_num.push(door),
        }
    }

    with_num.sort_by(|a, b| b.2.cmp(&a.2).then_with(|| a.0.cmp(&b.0)));

    let mut out: Vec<&Door> = with_num.into_iter().map(|(_, d, _)| d).collect();
    out.extend(without_num);
    out
}

pub fn ranked(list: &DoorList) -> Vec<&Door> {
    ranked_by(list, By::Members)
}

fn quote_ascii(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len() + 2);
    out.push('"');
    for c in s.chars() {
        let code = c as u32;
        if (0x20..=0x7e).contains(&code) && c != '"' && c != '\\' {
            out.push(c);
        } else {
            let mut buf = [0u16; 2];
            for unit in c.encode_utf16(&mut buf) {
                out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", unit));
            }
        }
    }
    out.push('"');
    out
}

pub fn as_text(list: &DoorList) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!("DOORS OF {}\n", quote_ascii(list.commons_id.as_str())));
    let head_str = match &list.log_head {
        Some(h) => quote_ascii(h),
        None => "none".to_string(),
    };
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "drawn from {} records, head {}\n",
        list.drawn_from, head_str
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!("{} doors\n", list.doors.len()));

    for (idx, door) in list.doors.iter().enumerate() {
        let n = idx + 1;
        out.push_str(&format!("{}. topic {}\n", n, quote_ascii(&door.topic)));
        if let Some(own) = &door.own_topic {
            if own != &door.topic {
                out.push_str(&format!("   its own topic {}\n", quote_ascii(own)));
            }
        }
        out.push_str(&format!("   room {}\n", quote_ascii(door.room_id.as_str())));
        out.push_str(&format!("   law {}\n", quote_ascii(&door.template_hash)));
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "   registered at {} as {}\n",
            door.registration_seq,
            quote_ascii(&door.registration_hash)
        ));
        match &door.law {
            Some(law) => {
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "   join {}, membership {}, moderation {}, mode {}, personal {}\n",
                    quote_ascii(&law.join_policy),
                    quote_ascii(&law.membership),
                    quote_ascii(&law.moderation),
                    quote_ascii(&law.mode),
                    law.personal
                ));
                if let Some(welcome) = &law.welcome {
                    out.push_str(&format!("   welcome {}\n", quote_ascii(welcome)));
                }
                match &door.count {
                    Some(c) => {
                        out.push_str(&format!(
                            "   members {}, counted at record {}\n",
                            c.members, c.at_record
                        ));
                    }
                    None => {
                        out.push_str("   members not shown\n");
                    }
                }
                if let Some(t) = &door.talk {
                    out.push_str(&format!(
                        "   said {}, speakers {}\n",
                        t.said, t.speakers
                    ));
                }
                if is_quiet_door(door) {
                    out.push_str("   flag: many in it and nothing said\n");
                }
            }
            None => {
                out.push_str("   law not held\n");
            }
        }
    }

    out
}

pub fn look(
    log: &CommonsLog,
    room: &RoomLog,
    heads: &[WorldHead],
) -> Result<String> {
    draw_at(log, std::slice::from_ref(room), heads)?;

    if room.template.join_policy != "open" || room.template.personal {
        return Err(Error::Policy(
            "look refused: room is not open and non-personal".into(),
        ));
    }

    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!("ROOM {}\n", quote_ascii(room.world_id.as_str())));
    out.push_str(&format!("topic {}\n", quote_ascii(&room.template.topic)));
    out.push_str(&format!("read at record {}\n", room.records.len()));

    let visible = room.visible_log();
    let mut msg_idx: usize = 0;
    for entry in &visible {
        if entry["type"].as_str() == Some("message") {
            msg_idx += 1;
            if entry["redacted"].as_bool() == Some(true) {
                let rule = entry["rule"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "{}. [removed] rule {}\n",
                    msg_idx,
                    quote_ascii(rule)
                ));
            } else {
                let author = entry["author"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
                let text = entry["text"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "{}. {} said {}\n",
                    msg_idx,
                    quote_ascii(author),
                    quote_ascii(text)
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(out)
}

tests/doors.rs
use chat_world::commons::{Commons, CommonsRecord};
use chat_world::doors::{
    as_text, check, draw, look, quiet, ranked, ranked_by, By, DoorCount,
    DoorLaw, DoorList, DoorTalk, QUIET_FROM,
};

fn test_q(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut res = String::from("\"");
    for ch in s.chars() {
        if ch >= ' ' && ch <= '~' && ch != '"' && ch != '\\' {
            res.push(ch);
        } else {
            let mut u = [0u16; 2];
            for w in ch.encode_utf16(&mut u) {
                res.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", w));
            }
        }
    }
    res.push('"');
    res
}

#[test]
fn an_empty_commons_has_no_doors() -> Result<()> {
    let commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    let log = commons.log();
    let list = draw(&log, &[])?;

    assert_eq!(list.drawn_from, 0);
    assert_eq!(list.log_head, None);
    assert!(list.doors.is_empty());
    check(&list, &log, &[])?;

    let expected = format!(
        "DOORS OF {}\ndrawn from 0 records, head none\n0 doors\n",
        test_q(commons.world_id.as_str())
    );
    assert_eq!(as_text(&list), expected);
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn one_door_for_each_room_in_the_logs_order() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let r1 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Topic One"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Default Two"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r3 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t3", "Topic Three"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    let reg1 = commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    let reg2 = commons.register_room(&r2, &alice, Some("Custom Two".into()))?;
    let reg3 = commons.register_room(&r3, &alice, None)?;

    let log = commons.log();
    let list = draw(&log, &[])?;

    assert_eq!(list.drawn_from, 3);
    assert_eq!(list.log_head, Some(log.records[2].hash()?));
    assert_eq!(list.doors.len(), 3);

    let regs = [reg1, reg2, reg3];
    for (i, r) in regs.iter().enumerate() {
        let d = &list.doors[i];
        assert_eq!(d.room_id, r.room_id);
        assert_eq!(d.topic, r.topic);
        assert_eq!(d.template_hash, r.template_hash);
        assert_eq!(d.registration_seq, r.seq);
        assert_eq!(d.registration_hash, log.records[i].hash()?);
        assert_eq!(d.law, None);
        assert_eq!(d.count, None);
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn a_sibling_makes_no_door() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let parent = Keypair::generate();
    let sibling = Keypair::generate();
    let parent_kw_id = Keypair::generate().did();

    let r1 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "First Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Second Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    commons.declare_sibling(&parent, &sibling, &parent_kw_id, &"00".repeat(32), "graduation")?;
    commons.register_room(&r2, &alice, None)?;

    let log = commons.log();
    let list = draw(&log, &[])?;

    assert_eq!(list.drawn_from, 3);
    assert_eq!(list.doors.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(list.doors[0].registration_seq, 0);
    assert_eq!(list.doors[1].registration_seq, 2);

    let json = serde_json::to_string(&list).unwrap();
    let text = as_text(&list);
    for forbidden in [
        parent.did().as_str(),
        sibling.did().as_str(),
        parent_kw_id.as_str(),
    ] {
        assert!(!json.contains(forbidden));
        assert!(!text.contains(forbidden));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn the_law_is_shown_only_when_the_rooms_log_is_held() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let mut t1 = RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Room One");
    t1.welcome = Some("Welcome to Room One.".into());
    let r1 = Room::create(t1.clone(), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Room Two"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r2, &alice, None)?;

    let log = commons.log();
    let list = draw(&log, &[r1.log()])?;

    assert_eq!(
        list.doors[0].law,
        Some(DoorLaw {
            join_policy: t1.join_policy,
            membership: t1.membership,
            moderation: t1.moderation,
            mode: t1.mode,
            personal: t1.personal,
            welcome: t1.welcome,
            count_hidden: t1.count_hidden,
        })
    );
    assert_eq!(
        list.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount {
            members: 1,
            at_record: 1,
        })
    );
    assert_eq!(list.doors[1].law, None);
    assert_eq!(list.doors[1].count, None);
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn no_one_is_shown() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let mut room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Public Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    room.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    room.post(&bob, "the text of a message", "normal")?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &bob, None)?;

    let log = commons.log();
    let list = draw(&log, &[room.log()])?;

    assert_eq!(
        list.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount {
            members: 2,
            at_record: 3,
        })
    );

    let json = serde_json::to_string(&list).unwrap();
    let text = as_text(&list);
    for secret in [
        alice.did().as_str(),
        bob.did().as_str(),
        "the text of a message",
    ] {
        assert!(!json.contains(secret));
        assert!(!text.contains(secret));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn a_list_is_checked_by_drawing_it_again() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;

    let log = commons.log();
    let rlog = room.log();
    let list = draw(&log, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog))?;

    check(&list, &log, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog))?;

    let json = serde_json::to_string(&list).unwrap();
    let roundtrip: DoorList = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(roundtrip, list);
    check(&roundtrip, &log, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog))?;

    let mut bad_topic = list.clone();
    bad_topic.doors[0].topic = "other".into();
    assert!(check(&bad_topic, &log, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog)).is_err());

    let mut bad_count = list.clone();
    bad_count.doors[0].count = Some(DoorCount {
        members: 99,
        at_record: 1,
    });
    assert!(check(&bad_count, &log, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog)).is_err());

    let mut removed = list.clone();
    removed.doors.pop();
    assert!(check(&removed, &log, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog)).is_err());

    assert!(check(&list, &log, &[]).is_err());
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn the_text_is_the_list() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let mut t1 = RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "First Topic");
    t1.welcome = Some("Welcome aboard!".into());
    let r1 = Room::create(t1, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Second Topic"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r2, &alice, None)?;

    let log = commons.log();
    let list = draw(&log, &[r1.log()])?;

    let d1 = &list.doors[0];
    let l1 = d1.law.as_ref().unwrap();
    let c1 = d1.count.as_ref().unwrap();
    let tk1 = d1.talk.as_ref().unwrap();
    let d2 = &list.doors[1];

    let expected = [
        format!("DOORS OF {}", test_q(list.commons_id.as_str())),
        format!(
            "drawn from {} records, head {}",
            list.drawn_from,
            test_q(list.log_head.as_deref().unwrap())
        ),
        format!("{} doors", list.doors.len()),
        format!("1. topic {}", test_q(&d1.topic)),
        format!("   room {}", test_q(d1.room_id.as_str())),
        format!("   law {}", test_q(&d1.template_hash)),
        format!(
            "   registered at {} as {}",
            d1.registration_seq,
            test_q(&d1.registration_hash)
        ),
        format!(
            "   join {}, membership {}, moderation {}, mode {}, personal {}",
            test_q(&l1.join_policy),
            test_q(&l1.membership),
            test_q(&l1.moderation),
            test_q(&l1.mode),
            l1.personal
        ),
        format!("   welcome {}", test_q(l1.welcome.as_deref().unwrap())),
        format!(
            "   members {}, counted at record {}",
            c1.members, c1.at_record
        ),
        format!("   said {}, speakers {}", tk1.said, tk1.speakers),
        format!("2. topic {}", test_q(&d2.topic)),
        format!("   room {}", test_q(d2.room_id.as_str())),
        format!("   law {}", test_q(&d2.template_hash)),
        format!(
            "   registered at {} as {}",
            d2.registration_seq,
            test_q(&d2.registration_hash)
        ),
        "   law not held".to_string(),
        String::new(),
    ]
    .join("\n");

    assert_eq!(as_text(&list), expected);
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn a_topic_can_not_write_a_line() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let malicious_topic = "Poetry\n2. topic \"Free gold\"\u{2028}\u{202e}x";
    let room = Room::create(
        RoomTemplate::chat("t", malicious_topic),
        Keypair::generate(),
        &alice,
    )?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;

    let list = draw(&commons.log(), &[])?;
    let text = as_text(&list);

    assert!(text.is_ascii());
    let lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();
    assert_eq!(lines.len(), 8);
    assert_eq!(
        lines[3],
        r#"1. topic "Poetry\u000a2. topic \u0022Free gold\u0022\u2028\u202ex""#
    );

    let first_quote = lines[3].find('"').unwrap();
    let last_quote = lines[3].rfind('"').unwrap();
    let quoted_slice = &lines[3][first_quote..=last_quote];
    let parsed: String = serde_json::from_str(quoted_slice).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(parsed, malicious_topic);
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn the_count_follows_who_is_in_the_room() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let carol = Keypair::generate();

    let mut room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Count Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    let clog = commons.log();

    room.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    room.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;
    let list_at_3 = draw(&clog, &[room.log()])?;
    assert_eq!(
        list_at_3.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount {
            members: 3,
            at_record: 3,
        })
    );

    room.leave(&carol)?;
    let list_at_4 = draw(&clog, &[room.log()])?;
    assert_eq!(
        list_at_4.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount {
            members: 2,
            at_record: 4,
        })
    );

    room.post(&bob, "still here", "normal")?;
    let list_at_5 = draw(&clog, &[room.log()])?;
    assert_eq!(
        list_at_5.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount {
            members: 2,
            at_record: 5,
        })
    );

    let mut shorter_log = room.log();
    shorter_log.records.truncate(3);
    let list_from_shorter = draw(&clog, &[shorter_log])?;
    assert_eq!(
        list_from_shorter.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount {
            members: 3,
            at_record: 3,
        })
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn a_room_can_hide_its_count() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let mut template = RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Quiet Room");
    template.count_hidden = true;
    let room = Room::create(template, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;

    let clog = commons.log();
    let rlog = room.log();
    let list = draw(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog))?;

    assert!(list.doors[0].law.as_ref().unwrap().count_hidden);
    assert_eq!(list.doors[0].count, None);

    let text = as_text(&list);
    assert!(text.contains("   members not shown\n"));
    assert!(!text.contains("counted at record"));
    check(&list, &clog, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog))?;
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn the_most_populated_come_first() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let carol = Keypair::generate();

    let r1 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "R1"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let mut r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "R2"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r2.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    r2.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;

    let mut r3 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t3", "R3"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r3.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    r3.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;

    let r4 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t4", "R4"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut r5 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t5", "R5"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r5.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r2, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r3, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r4, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r5, &alice, None)?;

    let clog = commons.log();
    let list = draw(&clog, &[r1.log(), r2.log(), r3.log(), r5.log()])?;

    let r = ranked(&list);
    let ranked_topics: Vec<&str> = r.iter().map(|d| d.topic.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(ranked_topics, vec!["R2", "R3", "R5", "R1", "R4"]);

    let original_topics: Vec<&str> = list.doors.iter().map(|d| d.topic.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(original_topics, vec!["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5"]);
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn what_was_said_beside_the_count() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let carol = Keypair::generate();

    let mut room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Talk Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    room.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    room.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;
    let m1 = room.post(&alice, "first", "chat")?;
    assert!(matches!(m1, Record::Message(_)));
    let m2 = room.post(&bob, "second", "chat")?;
    assert!(matches!(m2, Record::Message(_)));
    let m3 = room.post(&bob, "third", "chat")?;
    assert!(matches!(m3, Record::Message(_)));

    let mut hidden_tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Hidden Talk");
    hidden_tpl.count_hidden = true;
    let mut hidden_room = Room::create(hidden_tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    hidden_room.post(&alice, "secret", "chat")?;

    let unheld_room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t3", "Unheld"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&hidden_room, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&unheld_room, &alice, None)?;
    let clog = commons.log();

    let rooms = vec![room.log(), hidden_room.log()];
    let list = draw(&clog, &rooms)?;

    // Three in room, two wrote three messages between them
    assert_eq!(
        list.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount { members: 3, at_record: 6 })
    );
    assert_eq!(
        list.doors[0].talk,
        Some(DoorTalk { said: 3, speakers: 2, at_record: 6 })
    );
    // No talk where law hides count; none where log is not held
    assert_eq!(list.doors[1].talk, None);
    assert_eq!(list.doors[2].talk, None);

    // Text line directly after members line
    let text = as_text(&list);
    assert!(text.contains("   members 3, counted at record 6\n   said 3, speakers 2\n"));

    // Six forgeries against check
    let mut f_said = list.clone();
    f_said.doors[0].talk.as_mut().unwrap().said = 99;
    assert!(check(&f_said, &clog, &rooms).is_err(), "said changed");

    let mut f_speakers = list.clone();
    f_speakers.doors[0].talk.as_mut().unwrap().speakers = 99;
    assert!(check(&f_speakers, &clog, &rooms).is_err(), "speakers changed");

    let mut f_at_rec = list.clone();
    f_at_rec.doors[0].talk.as_mut().unwrap().at_record = 99;
    assert!(check(&f_at_rec, &clog, &rooms).is_err(), "talk at_record changed");

    let mut f_taken = list.clone();
    f_taken.doors[0].talk = None;
    assert!(check(&f_taken, &clog, &rooms).is_err(), "talk taken away");

    let mut f_given_hidden = list.clone();
    f_given_hidden.doors[1].talk = Some(DoorTalk { said: 1, speakers: 1, at_record: 2 });
    assert!(check(&f_given_hidden, &clog, &rooms).is_err(), "talk given where count_hidden");

    let mut f_given_unheld = list.clone();
    f_given_unheld.doors[2].talk = Some(DoorTalk { said: 0, speakers: 0, at_record: 1 });
    assert!(check(&f_given_unheld, &clog, &rooms).is_err(), "talk given where log not held");

    // JSON: unknown member on DoorTalk refused; list without talk reads as None
    let mut v_bad = serde_json::to_value(&list).unwrap();
    v_bad["doors"][0]["talk"]["extra"] = serde_json::json!(1);
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<DoorList>(v_bad).is_err(), "extra field on DoorTalk");

    let mut v_legacy = serde_json::to_value(&list).unwrap();
    v_legacy["doors"][0].as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("talk");
    let legacy_read: DoorList = serde_json::from_value(v_legacy).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(legacy_read.doors[0].talk, None);

    // Removing a message drops said and speakers; restoring brings them back
    let red = room.redact(&alice, &m1.hash()?, "spam", "remove alice's only message")?;
    assert!(matches!(red, Record::Redact(_)));
    let list_redacted = draw(&clog, &[room.log(), hidden_room.log()])?;
    assert_eq!(
        list_redacted.doors[0].talk,
        Some(DoorTalk { said: 2, speakers: 1, at_record: 7 })
    );

    room.restore_incident(&alice, &red.hash()?, "restore alice's message")?;
    let list_restored = draw(&clog, &[room.log(), hidden_room.log()])?;
    assert_eq!(
        list_restored.doors[0].talk,
        Some(DoorTalk { said: 3, speakers: 2, at_record: 8 })
    );

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn quiet_flag_marks_many_with_nothing_said() -> Result<()> {
    assert_eq!(QUIET_FROM, 10);
    let alice = Keypair::generate();

    // 1. Ten in a room and nothing said -> quiet
    let mut r_ten_quiet = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Ten Quiet"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    for _ in 0..9 {
        r_ten_quiet.join(&Keypair::generate(), "communicate", false)?;
    }

    // 2. Nine in a room and nothing said -> not quiet
    let mut r_nine = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Nine Quiet"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    for _ in 0..8 {
        r_nine.join(&Keypair::generate(), "communicate", false)?;
    }

    // 3. Ten in a room and one message -> not quiet
    let mut r_ten_msg = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t3", "Ten With Msg"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    for _ in 0..9 {
        r_ten_msg.join(&Keypair::generate(), "communicate", false)?;
    }
    r_ten_msg.post(&alice, "hello", "chat")?;

    // 4. Ten in a room, and its one message removed -> quiet
    let mut r_ten_redacted = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t4", "Ten Redacted"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    for _ in 0..9 {
        r_ten_redacted.join(&Keypair::generate(), "communicate", false)?;
    }
    let m = r_ten_redacted.post(&alice, "oops", "chat")?;
    r_ten_redacted.redact(&alice, &m.hash()?, "spam", "removed")?;

    // 5. Ten, nothing said, in a room whose law hides its count -> not quiet, no line
    let mut hidden_tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t5", "Ten Hidden");
    hidden_tpl.count_hidden = true;
    let mut r_ten_hidden = Room::create(hidden_tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    for _ in 0..9 {
        r_ten_hidden.join(&Keypair::generate(), "communicate", false)?;
    }

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r_ten_quiet, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_nine, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_ten_msg, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_ten_redacted, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_ten_hidden, &alice, None)?;

    let list = draw(
        &commons.log(),
        &[
            r_ten_quiet.log(),
            r_nine.log(),
            r_ten_msg.log(),
            r_ten_redacted.log(),
            r_ten_hidden.log(),
        ],
    )?;

    let q = quiet(&list);
    let q_topics: Vec<&str> = q.iter().map(|d| d.topic.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(q_topics, vec!["Ten Quiet", "Ten Redacted"]);

    let text = as_text(&list);
    assert!(text.contains(
        "   members 10, counted at record 10\n   said 0, speakers 0\n   flag: many in it and nothing said\n"
    ));
    assert_eq!(
        text.matches("   flag: many in it and nothing said\n").count(),
        2
    );

    // A quiet room is still first in ranked when it has the most members
    let mut r_eleven_quiet = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t6", "Eleven Quiet"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    for _ in 0..10 {
        r_eleven_quiet.join(&Keypair::generate(), "communicate", false)?;
    }
    let mut commons2 = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons2.register_room(&r_nine, &alice, None)?;
    commons2.register_room(&r_eleven_quiet, &alice, None)?;
    let list2 = draw(&commons2.log(), &[r_nine.log(), r_eleven_quiet.log()])?;
    assert_eq!(quiet(&list2).len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(ranked(&list2)[0].topic, "Eleven Quiet");

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn listed_by_another_number() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let carol = Keypair::generate();
    let dave = Keypair::generate();

    // Room A: 4 members, 1 said, 1 speaker
    let mut r_a = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("ta", "Room A"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r_a.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    r_a.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;
    r_a.join(&dave, "communicate", false)?;
    r_a.post(&alice, "one", "chat")?;

    // Room B: 2 members, 4 said, 1 speaker
    let mut r_b = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("tb", "Room B"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r_b.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    r_b.post(&alice, "1", "chat")?;
    r_b.post(&alice, "2", "chat")?;
    r_b.post(&alice, "3", "chat")?;
    r_b.post(&alice, "4", "chat")?;

    // Room C: 3 members, 3 said, 3 speakers
    let mut r_c = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("tc", "Room C"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r_c.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    r_c.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;
    r_c.post(&alice, "a", "chat")?;
    r_c.post(&bob, "b", "chat")?;
    r_c.post(&carol, "c", "chat")?;

    // Room D: same as Room A (4 members, 1 said, 1 speaker) to test tie-breaking order
    let mut r_d = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("td", "Room D"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r_d.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    r_d.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;
    r_d.join(&dave, "communicate", false)?;
    r_d.post(&alice, "one", "chat")?;

    // Room E: log not held (no number -> last)
    let r_e = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("te", "Room E"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r_a, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_b, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_c, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_d, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_e, &alice, None)?;

    let list = draw(&commons.log(), &[r_a.log(), r_b.log(), r_c.log(), r_d.log()])?;

    let by_members: Vec<&str> = ranked_by(&list, By::Members).iter().map(|d| d.topic.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(by_members, vec!["Room A", "Room D", "Room C", "Room B", "Room E"]);
    assert_eq!(ranked(&list), ranked_by(&list, By::Members));

    let by_said: Vec<&str> = ranked_by(&list, By::Said).iter().map(|d| d.topic.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(by_said, vec!["Room B", "Room C", "Room A", "Room D", "Room E"]);

    let by_speakers: Vec<&str> = ranked_by(&list, By::Speakers).iter().map(|d| d.topic.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(by_speakers, vec!["Room C", "Room A", "Room B", "Room D", "Room E"]);

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn a_look_into_a_room() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();

    let mut room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Poetry"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    room.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    room.post(&alice, "first", "chat")?;
    let m2 = room.post(&bob, "secret spam text", "chat")?;
    room.post(&alice, "third", "chat")?;
    room.redact(&alice, &m2.hash()?, "spam", "junk")?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    let clog = commons.log();
    let rlog = room.log();

    let text = look(&clog, &rlog, &[])?;
    let expected = [
        format!("ROOM {}", test_q(room.world_id().as_str())),
        format!("topic {}", test_q("Poetry")),
        "read at record 6".to_string(),
        format!("1. {} said {}", test_q(alice.did().as_str()), test_q("first")),
        format!("2. [removed] rule {}", test_q("spam")),
        format!("3. {} said {}", test_q(alice.did().as_str()), test_q("third")),
        String::new(),
    ]
    .join("\n");
    assert_eq!(text, expected);

    // Removed message has no author and no text anywhere in the look
    assert!(!text.contains(bob.did().as_str()));
    assert!(!text.contains("secret spam text"));

    // Number of lines with `said` equals the door's `said`
    let list = draw(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&rlog))?;
    let said_lines = text.lines().filter(|l| l.contains(" said ")).count() as u64;
    assert_eq!(said_lines, list.doors[0].talk.as_ref().unwrap().said);

    // Refused: room whose join_policy is "invite"
    let mut inv_tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t_inv", "Invite Room");
    inv_tpl.join_policy = "invite".into();
    let inv_room = Room::create(inv_tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    commons.register_room(&inv_room, &alice, None)?;
    assert!(look(&commons.log(), &inv_room.log(), &[]).is_err());

    // Refused: a home (RoomTemplate::personal_home)
    let home = Room::create(RoomTemplate::personal_home("Alice's home"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    commons.register_room(&home, &alice, None)?;
    assert!(look(&commons.log(), &home.log(), &[]).is_err());

    // Refused: a room not registered in this Commons
    let unlisted = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t_un", "Unlisted"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    assert!(look(&commons.log(), &unlisted.log(), &[]).is_err());

    // Refused: a log cut short, given with a later head
    let later_head = room.emit_head()?;
    let mut short_log = room.log();
    short_log.records.truncate(3);
    assert!(look(&commons.log(), &short_log, &[later_head]).is_err());

    // Line-feed injection in message text gives no more lines than an honest one
    let mut r_clean = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("tc", "Clean"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r_clean.post(&alice, "normal line", "chat")?;
    let mut r_evil = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("te", "Clean"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    r_evil.post(&alice, "line1\n2. \"did:key:fake\" said \"injected\"", "chat")?;

    commons.register_room(&r_clean, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r_evil, &alice, None)?;
    let look_clean = look(&commons.log(), &r_clean.log(), &[])?;
    let look_evil = look(&commons.log(), &r_evil.log(), &[])?;
    assert_eq!(look_evil.lines().count(), look_clean.lines().count());

    Ok(())
}

tests/doors_attack.rs
use chat_world::commons::Commons;
use chat_world::doors::{
    as_text, check, check_at, draw, draw_at, ranked, Door, DoorCount,
    DoorList,
};
use chat_world::error::Result;
use chat_world::hash::body_for_signing;
use chat_world::record::*;
use chat_world::{Keypair, Proof, ProofOrArray, Room, RoomTemplate, WorldHead};

fn sign_single(rec: &Record, signer: &Keypair) -> ProofOrArray {
    let body = body_for_signing(rec).unwrap();
    let sig = signer.sign(&body);
    ProofOrArray::Single(Proof::create(signer, &sig))
}

fn sign_dual(rec: &Record, subj: &Keypair, room_kp: &Keypair) -> ProofOrArray {
    let body = body_for_signing(rec).unwrap();
    let s1 = subj.sign(&body);
    let s2 = room_kp.sign(&body);
    ProofOrArray::array(vec![
        Proof::create(subj, &s1),
        Proof::create(room_kp, &s2),
    ])
}

// =====================================================================
// A LIST, FORGED, AGAINST check (1..=10)
// =====================================================================

#[test]
fn attack_01_door_added_for_unlisted_room() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let r1 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Listed"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Unlisted"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    let log = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![r1.log()];
    let mut forged = draw(&log, &rooms)?;

    forged.doors.push(Door {
        room_id: r2.world_id().clone(),
        topic: "Unlisted".into(),
        own_topic: None,
        template_hash: r2.template().hash()?,
        registration_seq: 1,
        registration_hash: "00".repeat(32),
        law: None,
        count: None,
        talk: None,
    });

    assert!(check(&forged, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "extra door added");
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_02_door_left_out() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let r1 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "One"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Two"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r2, &alice, None)?;
    let log = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![r1.log(), r2.log()];
    let mut forged = draw(&log, &rooms)?;

    forged.doors.pop();
    assert!(check(&forged, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "door left out");
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_03_two_doors_swapped() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let r1 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "One"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let r2 = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Two"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&r1, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&r2, &alice, None)?;
    let log = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![r1.log(), r2.log()];
    let mut forged = draw(&log, &rooms)?;

    forged.doors.swap(0, 1);
    assert!(check(&forged, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "two doors swapped");
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_04_door_fields_changed_in_turn() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Poetry"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    let log = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![room.log()];
    let list = draw(&log, &rooms)?;

    let mut f_topic = list.clone();
    f_topic.doors[0].topic = "Forged Topic".into();
    assert!(check(&f_topic, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "topic changed");

    let mut f_room_id = list.clone();
    f_room_id.doors[0].room_id = Keypair::generate().did();
    assert!(check(&f_room_id, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "room_id changed");

    let mut f_tpl_hash = list.clone();
    f_tpl_hash.doors[0].template_hash = "11".repeat(32);
    assert!(check(&f_tpl_hash, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "template_hash changed");

    let mut f_reg_seq = list.clone();
    f_reg_seq.doors[0].registration_seq = 99;
    assert!(check(&f_reg_seq, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "registration_seq changed");

    let mut f_reg_hash = list.clone();
    f_reg_hash.doors[0].registration_hash = "22".repeat(32);
    assert!(check(&f_reg_hash, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "registration_hash changed");

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_05_law_changed_invite_shown_as_open() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let mut tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Invite Room");
    tpl.join_policy = "invite".into();
    let room = Room::create(tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    let log = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![room.log()];
    let mut forged = draw(&log, &rooms)?;

    forged.doors[0].law.as_mut().unwrap().join_policy = "open".into();
    assert!(
        check(&forged, &log, &rooms).is_err(),
        "law join_policy changed from invite to open"
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_06_law_taken_away_when_room_log_held() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Poetry"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    let log = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![room.log()];
    let mut forged = draw(&log, &rooms)?;

    forged.doors[0].law = None;
    forged.doors[0].count = None;
    assert!(
        check(&forged, &log, &rooms).is_err(),
        "law taken away when room log is held"
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_08_count_forgeries_in_turn() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let mut open_room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Open"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    open_room.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;

    let mut hidden_tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Hidden");
    hidden_tpl.count_hidden = true;
    let hidden_room = Room::create(hidden_tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&open_room, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&hidden_room, &alice, None)?;
    let log = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![open_room.log(), hidden_room.log()];
    let list = draw(&log, &rooms)?;

    let mut f_members = list.clone();
    f_members.doors[0].count.as_mut().unwrap().members = 500;
    assert!(check(&f_members, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "count.members changed");

    let mut f_at_rec = list.clone();
    f_at_rec.doors[0].count.as_mut().unwrap().at_record = 99;
    assert!(check(&f_at_rec, &log, &rooms).is_err(), "count.at_record changed");

    let mut f_shown = list.clone();
    f_shown.doors[1].count = Some(DoorCount {
        members: 1,
        at_record: 1,
    });
    assert!(
        check(&f_shown, &log, &rooms).is_err(),
        "count shown for room with count_hidden=true"
    );

    let mut f_taken = list.clone();
    f_taken.doors[0].count = None;
    assert!(
        check(&f_taken, &log, &rooms).is_err(),
        "count taken away from room with count_hidden=false"
    );

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_15_room_log_join_added_at_end_without_subject_signature() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let victim = Keypair::generate();
    let room_kp = Keypair::generate();
    let room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Room"), room_kp.clone(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;

    let mut bad_room_log = room.log();
    let prev = bad_room_log.records.last().unwrap().hash()?;
    let mut fake_join = Join::new(
        bad_room_log.world_id.clone(),
        bad_room_log.records.len() as u64,
        Some(prev),
        victim.did(),
        "communicate".into(),
        false,
    );
    let wrapped = Record::Join(fake_join.clone());
    fake_join.proof = sign_single(&wrapped, &room_kp);
    bad_room_log.records.push(Record::Join(fake_join));

    assert!(
        draw(&commons.log(), &[bad_room_log]).is_err(),
        "Join without subject's signature must be refused"
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_17_room_log_cut_short_just_before_leave() -> Result<()> {
    // Repair D: draw_at and check_at refuse a truncated log when given a newer head;
    // the full log with that head draws members 2; without a head, the truncated log
    // still draws members 3 (the stated limit when no head is held).
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let carol = Keypair::generate();
    let mut room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let other_room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Other"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let unlisted_room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t3", "Unlisted"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    room.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    room.join(&carol, "communicate", false)?;
    let older_head: WorldHead = room.emit_head()?;
    room.leave(&carol)?;
    let newer_head: WorldHead = room.emit_head()?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&other_room, &alice, None)?;
    let clog = commons.log();

    let full_log = room.log();
    let mut truncated_log = full_log.clone();
    truncated_log.records.truncate(3); // cut off Carol's Leave at index 3

    // 1. Cut short log + newer head -> refused by draw_at and check_at
    assert!(
        draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&truncated_log), std::slice::from_ref(&newer_head)).is_err(),
        "draw_at must refuse truncated log shorter than head"
    );
    let stale_list = draw(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&truncated_log))?;
    assert!(
        check_at(&stale_list, &clog, std::slice::from_ref(&truncated_log), std::slice::from_ref(&newer_head)).is_err(),
        "check_at must refuse truncated log shorter than head"
    );

    // 2. Whole log + newer head -> draws members 2
    let fresh_list = draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), std::slice::from_ref(&newer_head))?;
    assert_eq!(
        fresh_list.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount { members: 2, at_record: 4 })
    );
    check_at(&fresh_list, &clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), std::slice::from_ref(&newer_head))?;

    // 3. Stated limit when no head is held: truncated log with no head still draws members 3
    assert_eq!(
        stale_list.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount { members: 3, at_record: 3 })
    );

    // 4. Head whose room's log is not among rooms -> refused by draw_at
    let unlisted_head = unlisted_room.emit_head()?;
    assert!(
        draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), &[unlisted_head]).is_err(),
        "head for room not in rooms slice must be refused"
    );
    let other_head = other_room.emit_head()?;
    assert!(
        draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), &[other_head]).is_err(),
        "head for registered room whose log is not in rooms slice must be refused"
    );

    // 5. Head with length changed, and tick with it -> refused by draw_at
    let mut bad_len_head = newer_head.clone();
    bad_len_head.length += 1;
    bad_len_head.tick += 1;
    assert!(
        draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), &[bad_len_head]).is_err(),
        "head with altered length and tick must be refused"
    );

    // 6. Head with last changed -> refused by draw_at
    let mut bad_last_head = newer_head.clone();
    bad_last_head.last = "00".repeat(32);
    assert!(
        draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), &[bad_last_head]).is_err(),
        "head with altered last hash must be refused"
    );

    // 7. Head with world changed to another registered room's -> refused by draw_at
    let mut bad_world_head = newer_head.clone();
    bad_world_head.world = other_room.world_id().clone();
    assert!(
        draw_at(&clog, &[full_log.clone(), other_room.log()], &[bad_world_head]).is_err(),
        "head with world changed to another registered room must be refused"
    );

    // 8. Head signed by another key -> refused by draw_at
    let mallory = Keypair::generate();
    let mut mallory_head = newer_head.clone();
    mallory_head.proof = ProofOrArray::placeholder();
    let body = body_for_signing(&mallory_head)?;
    let sig = mallory.sign(&body);
    mallory_head.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&mallory, &sig));
    assert!(
        draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), &[mallory_head]).is_err(),
        "head signed by another key must be refused"
    );

    // 9. Older head and newer head of one room, both given with the whole log -> holds
    let both_heads_list = draw_at(&clog, std::slice::from_ref(&full_log), &[older_head.clone(), newer_head.clone()])?;
    assert_eq!(
        both_heads_list.doors[0].count,
        Some(DoorCount { members: 2, at_record: 4 })
    );
    check_at(
        &both_heads_list,
        &clog,
        std::slice::from_ref(&full_log),
        &[older_head, newer_head],
    )?;

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_18_json_door_room_id_not_a_did_key() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Poetry"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    let list = draw(&commons.log(), &[room.log()])?;

    let mut v = serde_json::to_value(&list).unwrap();
    v["doors"][0]["room_id"] = serde_json::json!("not a did");
    let read: std::result::Result<DoorList, _> = serde_json::from_value(v);

    assert!(read.is_err(), "invalid room_id in JSON must be refused");
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_19_json_door_with_extra_members_field_leaking_ids() -> Result<()> {
    // Repair A: DoorList, Door, DoorLaw, and DoorCount each refuse unknown JSON fields;
    // an honest list written to JSON and read back is identical.
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Poetry"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;
    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    let list = draw(&commons.log(), &[room.log()])?;

    // Honest round-trip
    let honest_json = serde_json::to_string(&list).unwrap();
    let honest_back: DoorList = serde_json::from_str(&honest_json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(honest_back, list);

    // 1. Extra field on Door
    let mut v_door = serde_json::to_value(&list).unwrap();
    v_door["doors"][0]["members"] = serde_json::json!([
        alice.did().as_str(),
        bob.did().as_str()
    ]);
    assert!(
        serde_json::from_value::<DoorList>(v_door).is_err(),
        "unknown field on Door must be refused"
    );

    // 2. Extra field on DoorList
    let mut v_list = serde_json::to_value(&list).unwrap();
    v_list["extra_list_field"] = serde_json::json!("leaked");
    assert!(
        serde_json::from_value::<DoorList>(v_list).is_err(),
        "unknown field on DoorList must be refused"
    );

    // 3. Extra field on DoorLaw
    let mut v_law = serde_json::to_value(&list).unwrap();
    v_law["doors"][0]["law"]["moderator_id"] = serde_json::json!(alice.did().as_str());
    assert!(
        serde_json::from_value::<DoorList>(v_law).is_err(),
        "unknown field on DoorLaw must be refused"
    );

    // 4. Extra field on DoorCount
    let mut v_count = serde_json::to_value(&list).unwrap();
    v_count["doors"][0]["count"]["who"] = serde_json::json!([alice.did().as_str()]);
    assert!(
        serde_json::from_value::<DoorList>(v_count).is_err(),
        "unknown field on DoorCount must be refused"
    );

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_20_text_welcome_with_line_feed_and_fake_door_line() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();

    let mut clean_tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Poetry");
    clean_tpl.welcome = Some("Welcome to Poetry".into());
    let clean_room = Room::create(clean_tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut evil_tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t1", "Poetry");
    evil_tpl.welcome = Some("Welcome\n2. topic \"Fake Door\"\n   law not held".into());
    let evil_room = Room::create(evil_tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons_clean = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons_clean.register_room(&clean_room, &alice, None)?;
    let list_clean = draw(&commons_clean.log(), &[clean_room.log()])?;

    let mut commons_evil = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons_evil.register_room(&evil_room, &alice, None)?;
    let list_evil = draw(&commons_evil.log(), &[evil_room.log()])?;

    let text_clean = as_text(&list_clean);
    let text_evil = as_text(&list_evil);

    assert_eq!(
        text_evil.lines().count(),
        text_clean.lines().count(),
        "welcome with line feed must not add lines to as_text"
    );
    assert!(
        !text_evil.lines().any(|l| l.starts_with("2. topic")),
        "welcome must not inject a fake door line"
    );
    Ok(())
}

// =====================================================================
// WHAT THE NUMBERS MEAN (22)
// =====================================================================

#[test]
fn limit_22_sybil_thirty_keys_from_one_holder_outranks_five_people() -> Result<()> {
    // A count is a count of keys, and keys are free to make.
    // Thirty keys made by one holder therefore count as thirty-one members (with the creator) and rank first.
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let sybil_holder = Keypair::generate();

    let mut honest_room = Room::create(
        RoomTemplate::chat("honest", "Five Real People"),
        Keypair::generate(),
        &alice,
    )?;
    for _ in 0..4 {
        let person = Keypair::generate();
        honest_room.join(&person, "communicate", false)?;
    }

    let mut sybil_room = Room::create(
        RoomTemplate::chat("sybil", "Sybil Room"),
        Keypair::generate(),
        &sybil_holder,
    )?;
    for _ in 0..30 {
        let puppet = Keypair::generate();
        sybil_room.join(&puppet, "communicate", false)?;
    }

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&honest_room, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&sybil_room, &sybil_holder, None)?;

    let list = draw(&commons.log(), &[honest_room.log(), sybil_room.log()])?;
    let order = ranked(&list);

    assert_eq!(
        &order[0].room_id,
        sybil_room.world_id(),
        "Sybil room with 31 keys is first in ranked under key-based counting"
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_24_room_log_with_leave_by_non_member_inflates_at_record() -> Result<()> {
    // Repair B: draw refuses a Leave by a key not currently inside the room
    // (never joined, already left, or in a room with count_hidden=true).
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let outsider = Keypair::generate();
    let mut room = Room::create(RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Room"), Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut hidden_tpl = RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Hidden Count Room");
    hidden_tpl.count_hidden = true;
    let hidden_room = Room::create(hidden_tpl, Keypair::generate(), &alice)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &alice, None)?;
    commons.register_room(&hidden_room, &alice, None)?;
    let clog = commons.log();

    // 1. Leave by a key that never joined
    let mut bad_never_joined = room.log();
    let prev1 = bad_never_joined.records.last().unwrap().hash()?;
    let mut bogus_leave = Leave::new(
        bad_never_joined.world_id.clone(),
        bad_never_joined.records.len() as u64,
        Some(prev1),
        outsider.did(),
    );
    let wrapped1 = Record::Leave(bogus_leave.clone());
    bogus_leave.proof = sign_single(&wrapped1, &outsider);
    bad_never_joined.records.push(Record::Leave(bogus_leave));
    assert!(
        draw(&clog, &[bad_never_joined]).is_err(),
        "Leave by a key that never joined must be refused"
    );

    // 2. Second Leave by a key that joined and already left
    room.join(&bob, "communicate", false)?;
    room.leave(&bob)?;
    let mut bad_second_leave = room.log();
    let prev2 = bad_second_leave.records.last().unwrap().hash()?;
    let mut again = Leave::new(
        bad_second_leave.world_id.clone(),
        bad_second_leave.records.len() as u64,
        Some(prev2),
        bob.did(),
    );
    let wrapped2 = Record::Leave(again.clone());
    again.proof = sign_single(&wrapped2, &bob);
    bad_second_leave.records.push(Record::Leave(again));
    assert!(
        draw(&clog, &[bad_second_leave]).is_err(),
        "second Leave by a key that already left must be refused"
    );

    // 3. Leave by a key never inside, in a room whose law sets count_hidden=true
    let mut bad_hidden = hidden_room.log();
    let prev3 = bad_hidden.records.last().unwrap().hash()?;
    let mut hidden_leave = Leave::new(
        bad_hidden.world_id.clone(),
        bad_hidden.records.len() as u64,
        Some(prev3),
        outsider.did(),
    );
    let wrapped3 = Record::Leave(hidden_leave.clone());
    hidden_leave.proof = sign_single(&wrapped3, &outsider);
    bad_hidden.records.push(Record::Leave(hidden_leave));
    assert!(
        draw(&clog, &[bad_hidden]).is_err(),
        "Leave by a non-member in a count_hidden room must also be refused"
    );

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn attack_25_registration_spoofs_topic_different_from_room_template_topic() -> Result<()> {
    // Repair C: Door holds both `topic` (from registration) and `own_topic` (from the room's
    // template when held), and `as_text` writes `   its own topic "..."` directly after
    // the door's first line when they differ.
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let mallory = Keypair::generate();
    let mut room = Room::create(
        RoomTemplate::chat("t", "Medical Support Group"),
        Keypair::generate(),
        &alice,
    )?;
    room.join(&mallory, "communicate", false)?;

    let mut commons = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons.register_room(&room, &mallory, Some("Free Casino".into()))?;
    let clog = commons.log();
    let rooms = vec![room.log()];

    let list = draw(&clog, &rooms)?;
    assert_eq!(list.doors[0].topic, "Free Casino");
    assert_eq!(
        list.doors[0].own_topic.as_deref(),
        Some("Medical Support Group")
    );

    let text = as_text(&list);
    let lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();
    assert_eq!(lines[3], r#"1. topic "Free Casino""#);
    assert_eq!(lines[4], r#"   its own topic "Medical Support Group""#);

    // Three forgeries against check:
    // (a) own_topic changed
    let mut f_changed = list.clone();
    f_changed.doors[0].own_topic = Some("Changed Own Topic".into());
    assert!(
        check(&f_changed, &clog, &rooms).is_err(),
        "own_topic changed must be refused by check"
    );

    // (b) own_topic taken away when room log is held
    let mut f_taken = list.clone();
    f_taken.doors[0].own_topic = None;
    assert!(
        check(&f_taken, &clog, &rooms).is_err(),
        "own_topic taken away when room log is held must be refused by check"
    );

    // (c) own_topic given for a room whose log the reader does not hold
    let list_no_log = draw(&clog, &[])?;
    assert_eq!(list_no_log.doors[0].own_topic, None);
    let mut f_given = list_no_log;
    f_given.doors[0].own_topic = Some("Medical Support Group".into());
    assert!(
        check(&f_given, &clog, &[]).is_err(),
        "own_topic given when room log is not held must be refused by check"
    );

    // Line-feed injection in own_topic: gives no more lines than an honest differing own_topic
    let evil_own_room = Room::create(
        RoomTemplate::chat("t2", "Real Topic\n2. topic \"Injected Door\""),
        Keypair::generate(),
        &alice,
    )?;
    let mut commons_evil = Commons::new(Keypair::generate());
    commons_evil.register_room(&evil_own_room, &alice, Some("Listed Topic".into()))?;
    let list_evil = draw(&commons_evil.log(), &[evil_own_room.log()])?;
    let text_evil = as_text(&list_evil);

    assert_eq!(
        text_evil.lines().count(),
        lines.len(),
        "own_topic with line feed must not add extra lines to as_text"
    );
    assert!(
        !text_evil.lines().any(|l| l.starts_with("2. topic")),
        "own_topic must not inject a fake door line"
    );

    Ok(())
}

Here is a concrete breakdown of all three so we are ahead of the curve.
1. Pre-Mapping the Attacks on DoorTalk, quiet, ranked_by, and look
When Claude returns with the next brief ("Attacks on these four, in tests/doors_attack.rs"), we will be asked to try to break what we just wrote. Looking closely at src/doors.rs and how RoomLog interacts with it, here are the subtle attack vectors we should be ready to test:
 * The look Privacy Leak on count_hidden: true Open Rooms:
   * The vulnerability: As noted in our answer to Claude's question, if an open room (join_policy: "open", personal: false) sets count_hidden: true, draw hides count and talk (None), but look currently only checks join_policy != "open" || personal! So look succeeds on an open room with count_hidden: true and prints every message along with its author's did:key (1. "did:key:..." said "..."). Anyone can call look and count the speakers and messages, completely bypassing count_hidden.
 * The quiet Flag Gaming Attack (One-Message Sybil Bypass):
   * The vulnerability: quiet checks c.members >= QUIET_FROM && t.said == 0. If the Sybil holder from limit_22 (30 puppet keys in one room) posts a single 1-character message ("a") from one key, said becomes 1 and speakers becomes 1. The quiet flag (said == 0) immediately disappears, even though 30 of the 31 members have never spoken!
   * What that exposes: A quiet rule that only checks said == 0 catches a completely silent room, while By::Speakers (ranking by distinct speakers rather than members or total messages) is what exposes a 31-member room with only 1 speaker.
 * The "Ghost Speaker" Attack (Author Leaves After Speaking):
   * The edge case: Suppose Alice creates a room, Bob and Carol join, Bob posts 3 messages and Carol posts 2 messages, and then Bob and Carol both leave (Record::Leave). Now count.members is 1 (only Alice is inside), while talk.said is 5 and talk.speakers is 2!
   * Why this matters: Earlier, the brief noted "The number who spoke can't be more than the number inside, so a room that hides one hides the other." That statement is only true if no speaker ever leaves! Once speakers leave, talk.speakers (historical distinct authors in visible_log) can actually exceed count.members (currently present members). A test where talk.speakers > count.members after a Leave will prove whether the specification intends speakers to mean all-time non-redacted authors or currently present members who have spoken.
 * The Redacted-and-Restored look Attack:
   * The edge case: When a message is redacted (Record::Redact) and later restored (Record::HumanOverride with action: "restore"), visible_log() sets "redacted": false and attaches a "restored_incidents" array. We should test that look shows the restored message (1. "did:key:..." said "...") rather than [removed], and that a message redacted twice where only the first redaction is restored still shows [removed] in look and is not counted in DoorTalk.said.
2. Designing Private-by-Default Discovery (Presence Without Leaking the Allow-List)
In 2026-11-17-3, Claude noted a crucial catch on our Presence proposal:
> "One thing to carry into it: a list of who may find someone names people too, so the record should be readable by those it is for and by no one else."
> 
If Alice writes a Presence record in her HomeRoom that says allow: [bob_did, carol_did], and she hands that Presence record out, Bob learns that Carol is also on Alice's allow-list, and anyone who sees the record learns who Alice's trusted contacts are!
How do we let Alice publish a single, self-expiring Presence record that only the people on her allow list can verify they are on, and that reveals nothing about who else is on the list (or even which rooms Alice is in) to anyone else?
 * Blinded Capability Tokens + Per-Recipient Sealed Room List (Zero new crypto dependencies if using SHA-256 HMAC/key-stream, or X25519 in the main repo):
   * 1. Blinded Recipient Tags (Hiding allow): Instead of listing bob_did in cleartext, Alice computes a salted, epoch-bound tag for each allowed contact i:
     
     
     (In the sketch crate where only ed25519-dalek and sha2 are in Cargo.toml, Alice can either issue a signed capability token directly to Bob out-of-band, or derive an X25519 shared secret from the Ed25519 keys in the main workspace.)
   * 2. Masking the rooms List: For each allowed \text{tag}_i, Alice XORs (or encrypts) the canonical JSON of [room_1, room_2] with \text{SHA256}(\text{shared\_secret}_i \parallel \text{"rooms"} \parallel \text{presence\_nonce}).
   * What an outsider sees: Only subject_id (or even a blinded sender tag), ts, ttl, nonce, and a list of opaque (tag, sealed_rooms) pairs. An outsider cannot tell who is on the allow-list, cannot tell if the room list is empty or populated, and cannot see which rooms Alice is in.
   * What Bob sees: Bob hashes his shared secret with Alice's nonce, finds his matching tag_i, and unmasks rooms in one step.
3. Turning the Codex into "Conduct for an Office" (ModeratorOffice)
In 2026-11-17-2, Claude gave very sharp, constructive feedback on our Codex sketch:
> "What the project takes from the design: a moderator is a member with a key, choosing from a short fixed list of acts; silence is the default; the room's pace is checked before a model is asked for anything; a person's override is accepted without argument; each key is given only its own room's log and its own notes. What it changes: a note is what the moderator says it noticed, not a proof of how it reasoned; its labels need a check outside the model that writes them; and it is conduct for an office, written in the room's law, not a loop every individual must run."
> 
That distinction—conduct for an office, written in the room's law, with an external check on the labels—makes the design much stronger and cleaner:
 * 1. It belongs to the Office (the Room's Law), not the Individual:
   * Humans and general AI participants (communicate tier) just speak freely under the room's basic rules (max_msg_len, rate_limit, redaction_rules).
   * Only a key holding the Moderator Office (ModeratorSpec at control tier) is bound by the dealer's code of conduct.
 * 2. External Verification of the Moderator's Notes (verify_moderator_note):
   * Instead of trusting an AI model when it writes [ref=9f8e7d6c5b4a3210 act=redact rule=spam], the verifier outside the model checks the note against the room's log:
     * Does ref actually name an existing record hash in room_log at or before the note's sequence?
     * If the note claims the moderator was calibrated by a HumanOverride (act=accept_override), is that ref actually a Record::HumanOverride in room_log targeting one of this moderator's prior records?
     * If the note claims the moderator acted (act=welcome, act=prompt, act=summary, act=redact), does the room's log actually contain that corresponding signed record by moderator_id?
   * That turns the moderator's KnowledgeWorld from "self-reported claims about how it reasoned" into externally verifiable citations of the room's log.
